text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I finished up the bulk of my work and was stretching,
a polite knock echoed from the door.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
are you free after this?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you don't mind, there's a place
I'd like you to accompany me to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, once work was finished, Chairwoman Akikawa
and I made our way to the Furlong Tower.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Delicious!
This strawberry tower frappe is superb!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It tastes just as it did when I drank it with Mother.
...Back then, I couldn't finish it on my own, so we shared it.
choice_data_list: Did you come here just to get that drink, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! Negative!
――Objective: Aim even higher.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! My apologies, my apologies!
I forgot there was a glass floor on this level.
...To think I would end up shivering in fright once again!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Just one more floor up, and—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: An observation deck, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The night view stretching out before my eyes took my breath away with its beauty.
I instinctively turned to share my impressions with the person who brought me here, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the top of the stairs,
she gazed at the night view in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Was the view something special?
choice_data_list: Yes! Chairwoman, would you like to watch up close as well?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!
That is true. ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I invited you along today just for this, after all.
*inhale*... *exhale*...
choice_data_list: Are you afraid of heights, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! No need to fret!
That is not what I meant at all.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—The scenery there
is deeply intertwined with saying goodbye to Mother, you see.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
It's surprising, isn't it? An academy that vast
looks like nothing more than a single speck of light from far away.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
Yayoi... You know, the world is much bigger
than what you can see through your own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text: That's why Mommy wants to help everyone spread their wings and fly even higher across the world's wide skies.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "So that someday the Umamusume, everyone――and you, too――will possess the strength to view this wide world."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...I remember every single word.
Back then, however, I just couldn't bring myself to face that scenery.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hesitation. The moment my eyes took in the vastness of the world,
I felt as if I would have no choice but to accept that Mother was going far away.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Yet looking back now.
The view from here is――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...It's so spacious and beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...I shouldn't be so strangely stubborn.
No matter how vast the world is... even if you close your eyes once—you can always meet the people you want to see.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I have learned. With everyone's aid.
Through learning... I have grown once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa smiled by the window as she looked at the light.
Not a single trace of loneliness seemed to remain on her face.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you,
Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, descending Furlong Tower,
on the way back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In the future!
More and more people will surely follow Mother's footsteps and take their talents from Japan to the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Among them――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...I imagine both you and <chrname> will be there too.
choice_data_list: And someday, the Chairwoman should join us too!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
choice_data_list: Didn't your mother say so as well, Chairwoman?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only just heard the story from Chairwoman Akikawa.
Her mother wished for Umamusume, and for Chairwoman Akikawa herself,
to acquire the power to see the entire world with broad vision.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh…… Hahaha!
What an invitation! Asking me to join as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The future! Perhaps a path like that exists too!
If someone emerges whom I can entrust with what comes next in peace... someone who will inherit my will.
choice_data_list: There are plenty of people who look up to you, Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You flatter me!
Yet if you say so――
perhaps that really is the case.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ........Among them was.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...My mistake!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The day may come when you take off
into the wider world alongside <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I'll continue to count on you going forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took her outstretched hand and gripped it firmly,
as if reaffirming our unyielding bond.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Until the day you all venture forth.
I shall stay by your side forever.
